description: Lucida flag reason (gateway flagOut.reason / local evaluator Result.reason) -> OpenFeature reason. `variant_reason` applies when the resolved value is a variant string (multivariate bucket). Unknown reasons map to UNKNOWN. Every OpenFeature provider maps through this table and tests against it (N-EXP-2).
notes: flagMetadata.lucidaReason always carries the raw Lucida reason (e.g. "fallback", "kill_switch").

Reason `fallback` is served by the SDK (init-time `fallbacks` map, N-EXP-16) when evaluation fails or the flag is missing; providers return the fallback value with OpenFeature reason DEFAULT and no errorCode so the OpenFeature SDK keeps the value.
A missing flag without a fallback is errorCode FLAG_NOT_FOUND, reason ERROR.
